correctness.rationale: The ordered Dirichlet(1,...,1) simplex has spacings Y_k=sum_{j>=k}P_j/j and the quadratic statistic equals sum_{a,b}P_a P_b/max(a,b). Third Dirichlet moments give Cov(P_j,G)=2(H_m-H_(j-1)-1)/[m(m+1)(m+2)], and the harmonic double sum gives (A_k^2+B_k-2A_k)/[m(m+1)(m+2)]. Consecutive numerators differ by 2(A_k-1)/k; endpoint signs and monotonic harmonic tails prove one crossover. For k/m->alpha, the exact variances Var(Y_k)=(mB_k-A_k^2)/[m^2(m+1)] and Var(G)=4(m-1)/[(m+1)^2(m+2)(m+3)] give claimed Pearson limit, with positive limiting denominator for alpha in (0,1). Independently evaluated 27 exact third-moment covariance cases m=2..7; finite checks supplement the all-m algebra.
